result.notes:
Added [orch.research] (policy, sources.<id>: kind command|filesystem|mcp-stdio, argv restricted to defaults/machine/invocation/flags, tool, roots, capabilities, timeout_s, concurrency, order) to config.schema.json and Settings.research. New orch/research/sources.py has the command, filesystem and generic stdlib mcp-stdio adapters, normalised to {source,text,sources,raw_ref}. BROWSER_BUSY and timeouts are retried up to 3 times through retry.decide, then SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE. In-process concurrency gate. CLI: orch.py research sources/query. Docs: research.md with the Perplexity machine-config example, configuration.md, index.md and CHANGELOG. Tests with a fake mcp-stdio server and CONFIG_LAYER_FORBIDDEN for a project argv (24 tests, green). Blocked: affected-tests fails only on ECOSYSTEM_CONFIG_EXAMPLE_DRIFT of packages/orch/config.example.toml, a generated file outside the write set.
